user_authorization_basis: User authorized migration and continuation after independent audit and asked for a clean post-completion subagent review.

material_correction_required: demand reversal requires material AI-linked persistent evidence evaluated under a predeclared threshold
product margin working-capital attribution and reconciled cash-flow conversion remain separate gates
nonmaterial_corrections_required: company revenue and profit co-growth is not a proved conversion
free cash flow is identified as deterministic non-GAAP OCF-minus-capex
absolute inventory balance is context rather than AI-risk corroboration
post-normalization order behavior helps distinguish rather than resolves competing explanations

token_budget_basis.node_purpose: No model node is created; deterministic text substitution repairs seven independently identified financial-expression surfaces.
token_budget_basis.input_scale: One immutable R15 candidate, one independent review receipt, and two protected-authority contracts.
token_budget_basis.required_outputs: One private full result, one public receipt, exact change inventory, contract audit, trusted report, and deterministic rendering.
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: Bind all source hashes and digests, preserve topology and every reference/gap inventory, and record zero-call execution.
token_budget_basis.materiality_quality_risk: Unbounded reversal rules or stock-to-cash wording can invert a thesis or imply unsupported product cash conversion.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: R15 protected-contract pass plus its failed clean independent content review.
token_budget_basis.stop_and_truncation: Fail closed on any source drift, unauthorized path or reference change, contract finding, topology drift, or pre-existing output.
